newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto EPS adjusted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto EPS adjusted.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Tuesday she lowered her second quarter earnings estimate to $0.67 a share from $0.71 and her third quarter estimate to $0.30 a share from $0.32.
-- Her fourth quarter estimate remains $0.17 a share and her full-year estimate remains $1.70 a share.
-- Earlier, Monsanto reported first quarter earnings before charges of $0.56 a share, above Dain Bosworth's estimate of $0.50 a share and the Street estimate of $0.51.
-- "We are leaving our full-year estimate unchanged at $1.70 as some Roundup (herbicide) sales may have been pulled into the first quarter," Wittenburg wrote in a report.

-- She reiterated her buy rating, adding the stock has recovered from concerns about dilution due to the pending Holden's Foundation Seeds Inc acquisition. "...(W)e expect continued improvement from here," she added.
